revisionReason: User authorized operational application of the completed channel slice and requested readable interpretation of data-watch posts.
sourceRequest: 우선 지금까지 진행한것들은 운영 적용 진행해줘 / 근데 data-watch 에 발송된 내용들은 뭘 의미해? 가독성이 너무 떨어지는데
outcome: Operate the completed Maintainer and data-watch channel slice, make data-watch messages readable, verify actual Slack delivery and preserve production evidence.
constraints: Company records and evidence remain only in this repository; research/data repositories are read-only targets.
Signed allowlisted Slack ingress, typed proposals, deterministic Temporal/PostgreSQL state, and uncertain-effect receipts remain mandatory.
Preserve research worker and existing Quant Scout/account-gateway runtime during the channel release.
Do not activate other inactive employees or fixed research-input checks without their own validated activation.
Do not infer source corruption, data lateness or completed core checks from catalog/footer inspection.

deliverables.description: Apply approved Maintainer and data-watch channel slice to production
acceptance: Exact release deployed with existing services preserved
Live Slack summary and incident reply matched to durable receipts
Production service and authorized status observations recorded

deliverables.description: Explain data-watch status in short Korean messages
acceptance: One concise daily summary instead of Slack split messages
Footer limit explained without implying corruption or lateness
Full dataset names available on request and raw internal hashes omitted from Slack

deliverables.description: Retain local, CI, and live evidence with stated limits
acceptance: Real PostgreSQL/Temporal regression and deployment checks pass
Code commit and backup receipts recorded
Unverified owner inbound and fixed research-input checks remain explicit

nonGoals: Automatic source data repair or changes to approved research inputs
Heavy research, training, backtests or live orders
Claiming live end-to-end checks that were not performed
stopConditions: Never automatically replay an uncertain Slack write or charge
Do not claim data delay without an approved freshness contract
